notes: Hard. The agent ships a native C/C++ math stack (/app/math) plus a reproducible driver /app/solve.py. Work is strictly staged and chained: author sources + Makefile + CMake -> build with make/cmake/clang -> drive the sim (measures work), maximal-square DP, natC ctypes binding -> report answer.json (dependent_stages=3). It must combine a multi-target make build, an OpenMP variant, a CMake target that emits per-translation-unit .ll, ctypes, and a plain python DP (tool_breadth=3). The native binding has an unpatched length/alias mismatch whose signature is all-zero outputs; diagnosing and patching it is genuinely ambiguous from the behaviour alone (debugging_ambiguity=3). Correctness is exact: OT streaming prefix equality, DP area equality, a real serial-vs-openmp speedup in a tight band, exact serial==openmp position checksums (quantitative=3). solve.py re-runs over fresh/malformed hidden fixtures (hidden_case_generalization=2), including empty/single-row grids and degenerate value lists (adversarial=2). Two hard-gated competencies (O(n) serial+OpenMP sim, binding patch) and the speed-report competency drive the difficulty.
